mapper.select: select u.user_id,lm.id member_id,u.dept_id,r.role_key,lm.biz_line from sys_user u join lab_member lm on lm.user_id=u.user_id and lm.member_status='ACTIVE' and lm.del_flag='0' join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0' where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' and r.role_key in ('lab_manager','lab_lead','lab_member') order by case r.role_key when 'lab_manager' then 1 when 'lab_lead' then 2 else 3 end limit 1
